note: Sample venue for demo mode only. Positions match assets/images/sample-site-map.png (drawn by scripts/draw-sample-map.mjs). The real map, pins and details are entered by staff.

places.name: Main Lot
places.description: Main family parking. Follow the signs from the entrance; the check-in tent is a short walk up the path.

places.name: Lot B (overflow)
places.description: Overflow parking when the Main Lot is full. Trolley stop at the lot entrance.

places.name: Bus & RV Lot
places.description: Team buses and RVs.

places.name: Check-in Tent
places.description: Arrival day check-in. Bring each player’s QR pass from the app. Uniforms and wristbands are handed out here.

places.name: Trolley stop: Main Lot
places.description: The trolley loops the park so nobody has to climb the big hills: Main Lot → Fields 1–6 → Bunkhouse Village → Fields 7–12.

places.name: Trolley stop: Fields 1–6
places.description: Top of the first hill, by Field 3.

places.name: Trolley stop: Bunkhouse Village
places.description: Up the steepest hill. Ride up, walk down.

places.name: Trolley stop: Fields 7–12
places.description: Between Fields 9 and 10.

places.name: Bunkhouse Row A
places.description: Bunkhouses A1–A12.

places.name: Bunkhouse Row B
places.description: Bunkhouses B1–B12.

places.name: Bunkhouse Row C
places.description: Bunkhouses C1–C12.

places.name: Bunkhouse Row D
places.description: Bunkhouses D1–D12.

places.name: Main Concessions
places.description: Order in the app and we bring it to your dugout.

places.name: The Clubhouse
places.description: The original sit-down spot at the park: burgers, wings and the big screen.

places.name: New Restaurant
places.description: The new restaurant on the hill. Sample name, staff set the real one.

places.name: Home Run Dugout
places.description: Topgolf-style hitting bays: swing for targets, compete with your team.

places.name: Monster Milkshake
places.description: Over-the-top milkshakes piled high with candy, cookies and cake.

places.name: Pro Cards & Jerseys Trailer
places.description: Real baseball cards and jerseys of pro players.

places.name: Custom Apparel
places.description: Custom shirts and hats printed on site with your team name.

places.name: Glossy Finish
places.description: On-site vendor. Staff add the details.

places.name: First Aid
places.description: Athletic trainers on duty during games.

places.name: Info & Pro Shop
places.description: Questions, lost and found, and official apparel pickup.

around.name: National Baseball Hall of Fame and Museum
around.description: The heart of baseball history: plaques, artifacts and exhibits. Plan a few hours.

around.name: Doubleday Field
around.description: The historic ballpark a short walk from the Hall of Fame.

around.name: Main Street Cooperstown
around.description: Baseball card shops, bat makers, souvenirs, ice cream and pizza.

around.name: Otsego Lake
around.description: Boat tours, swimming and sunsets at the north end of Main Street.

around.name: The Farmers’ Museum
around.description: A working 1800s village with a hand-carved carousel.

around.name: Fenimore Art Museum
around.description: American art and folk art on the shore of Otsego Lake.

around.name: Glimmerglass State Park
around.description: Beach, hiking and picnics at the top of the lake.

around.name: Fly Creek Cider Mill
around.description: Fresh cider, fudge and tastings in a historic mill.

around.name: Howe Caverns
around.description: Underground boat ride through limestone caves. A good rain-day trip.

around.name: Sample Hotel (Oneonta)
around.description: Sample listing for the demo. Staff add the real hotels, inns and rentals nearby.
